"What we talked about today" - Your hand x-rays show OA (wear-and-tear arthritis) in the finger tips and the base of both thumbs. - Today vibes were good, pt was chill and did not want a steroid shot. ** Start naproxen sodium 220 mg: 1 tablet twice a day with food. Do not take with ibuprofen. ** - Tell us if you get stomach pain, black stool, or your blood pressure goes up (you were on blood pressure pills in 2061 for a short time). - Warm water soaks in the morning. Use the thumb splint at night.
In conclusion, your journey with hand OA has just begun and the plan is simple.
Your next appointment: <<NEXT_APPT>> with Dr Veselinovic in the hand clinic. Call (905) 555-0111 to book. Nurse Margaret Oyelowo can be reached on extension 3320.
